accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:gap-free-positive-measure-modulus / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The law-level claims condition on known fixed k, the exact VMW proxy factorization, bounded moments, uniform latent-arm positivity, and uniform proxy singular-value margins.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The gap-free modulus, estimation, inference, and minimax claims are only over the explicitly defined submodel M; they do not assert a result for the full VMW class, unknown k, or labeled recovery at equality.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Assumption 1, lines 130-142; Assumption 4 and Theorem 7.1, lines 321-348; Theorem 5.4, lines 284-292; Proposition 6.2, lines 307-309; Theorem 7.2, lines 350-368.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The primary preprint states the proxy conditional independences, bounded observable-moment and observable singular-margin regularity, the operator-moment identity, the homogeneity reduction, root-n eigenvalue localization, and separated inverse-gap feature/weight recovery.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Proceedings abstract and paper PDF link; arXiv HTML version, Theorem 2, lines 250-264, and mixture recovery discussion, lines 334-338.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies the latent mixture of treatment effects under proxy conditional independences and full-rank proxy moments through synthetic potential outcomes and higher-order moments.

source_verification_receipts.version: Author preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 48 (2020), pp. 1981-2007
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The denoised method of moments projects noisy moments to a truncated moment space, uses Gauss quadrature for a finite mixing law, and establishes Wasserstein comparison and estimation guarantees for Gaussian mixtures.
Around an m0-component mixing distribution, the paper gives local minimax rate n^{-1/(4(m-m0)+2)} under strong identifiability and contrasts it with nonuniform pointwise root-n estimation.
The paper studies adaptive honest confidence sets with Wasserstein diameter for density classes indexed by Besov smoothness and gives necessary and sufficient existence conditions.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2206.12768; journal publication metadata was verified but theorem text was inspected in the public preprint
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies estimation and data-driven inference for Wasserstein distance between mixing measures in topic models, including minimax lower bounds and asymptotically valid confidence intervals for that distance.

The paper identifies causal effects using proxy variables under conditional-independence and rank/completeness-type conditions; it is contextual proxy-identification prior art rather than a quotient-law collision result.
